name: OpenMontage
description: World's first open-source, agentic video production system. 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files. Turn your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio.
one_liner: Turns an AI coding assistant into a mini video studio: you describe the video you want and it researches, writes the script, generates clips and voiceover, and edits a finished video — for pennies to a few dollars in compute.
buyer: A solo content creator or small marketing team who needs a steady stream of short video content but can't afford an editor or stock footage licenses.
business_use_cases: A YouTube explainer channel uses it to turn a blog post into a narrated video with captions and stock-style motion footage in a single afternoon.
A small e-commerce brand generates short product-demo and ad videos in-house instead of paying $500-2000 per video to a freelance editor.
A social media agency offers 'AI video production' as a cheap add-on tier for clients who can't afford full video production.

money_ideas.idea: Run a video-as-a-service shop for small businesses: client describes the video, you run the pipeline, deliver a finished cut, charge per video.
Offer a monthly 'content engine' subscription producing a batch of short social videos per month for a brand.

steal_this: This weekend, pick a niche (real estate listings, local restaurant promos, product demos) and produce five sample videos using the tool, then pitch a $200/month video retainer to three local businesses.
